packages.name: hello
packages.desc: minimal WASI hello-world (writes "hello, osito\n" to stdout)

packages.name: echo
packages.desc: reads argv and prints each arg on its own line

packages.name: cat
packages.desc: stream stdin to stdout in 4 KiB chunks

packages.name: wc
packages.desc: count lines and bytes from stdin (POSIX wc -lc)

packages.name: rev
packages.desc: reverse each line from stdin (POSIX rev)

packages.name: upper
packages.desc: ascii a-z -> A-Z, like tr a-z A-Z

packages.name: grep
packages.desc: filter stdin lines containing argv[1] substring (no regex)

packages.name: head
packages.desc: print first N lines (head 5 or head -n 5; default 10)
